You can get a relevance score by inputting query and passage to the reranker. And the score can be mapped to a float value in [0,1] by sigmoid function. BAAI/bge-reranker ...

sources.title: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3: Multilingual Cross-Encoder Reranker | Hugging ...
sources.snippet: BGE Reranker v2 M3 is a cross-encoder reranking model by BAAI, built on XLM-RoBERTa, supporting 100+ languages. It outputs relevance scores for query-document pairs, achieving state-of-the-art results on multilingual retrieval benchmarks.
